items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: Bill Matthews. Oh man. That's right. Saw him last night. You dog. It says Bill, he was playing drums with us.

ctx.x: Well, Joe was good too. Joe was very good. I played with him a lot too. Well, Joe was powerful. He didn't have too much of a tone, but he was good for jazz because he could make all that, he could make it go like a dog and all that, you understand? You know, that wah-wah stuff and he'd make all that on the horn, you know? And he was strong, you know, he's a big fella, as big as you, you know? You saw him, huh? No. You ever seen? Same picture, he's a terrible picture. Yeah, he was a very big fella. I got a picture…
Not as big as me, though.
